boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Reseda Boulevard, Nordhoff Street, and Dearborn Street, each with one specific reason to leave campus.

cards.title: Mediterranean Meets Comfort Food
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 9250 Reseda Blvd., Suite 1
cards.notes: Walk south on Reseda Boulevard for American comfort food with Mediterranean flair; review the current menu before choosing a meal.
cards.short_summary: A nearby sit-down option combining familiar American dishes with Mediterranean influences.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN identifies Emle’s Restaurant at 9250 Reseda Boulevard, Suite 1, and describes its food as American comfort fare with Mediterranean flair.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant listed 0.3 miles from CSUN; check the restaurant’s current operating details before visiting.

cards.title: Three Mediterranean Traditions
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 9310 Reseda Blvd.
cards.notes: Use this Reseda Boulevard stop when your group wants Greek, Middle Eastern, and Persian influences represented on one menu.
cards.short_summary: A close-to-campus restaurant spanning several regional Mediterranean cooking traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN lists Lemon Zest at 9310 Reseda Boulevard and describes it as modern Mediterranean food with Greek, Middle Eastern, and Persian influences.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant listed 0.2 miles from CSUN; confirm current operating details before departure.

cards.title: Cajun Seafood, Asian Inflection
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 9545 Reseda Blvd.
cards.notes: Head north on Reseda Boulevard for a seafood-focused meal that combines Cajun-style boils with Asian fusion flavors.
cards.short_summary: A nearby seafood destination built around a clearly documented cross-cultural menu.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN places Kickin KAsian at 9545 Reseda Boulevard and characterizes the restaurant as Cajun seafood boil meeting Asian fusion.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant listed 0.3 miles from CSUN; consult current business information before visiting.

cards.title: A Dedicated Tea Break
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 9663 Reseda Blvd.
cards.notes: Continue north along Reseda Boulevard when the plan calls for a focused tea-and-boba stop rather than a full restaurant meal.
cards.short_summary: A beverage-centered option for tea and boba within CSUN’s practical off-campus orbit.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN lists Bon Bon Tea House at 9663 Reseda Boulevard and specifically describes its offerings as flavorful teas and boba.
cards.access_notes: Public tea shop listed 0.5 miles from CSUN; verify current operating details before setting out.

cards.title: Ube Across the Counter
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 9717 Reseda Blvd.
cards.notes: Follow Reseda Boulevard north for an ube-centered café visit, with drinks, lattes, pastries, and shakes documented by CSUN.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-and-drinks café where ube provides the stop’s specific identity.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN lists Cafe 86 at 9717 Reseda Boulevard and says the café serves ube drinks, lattes, pastries, and shakes.
cards.access_notes: Public café listed 0.5 miles from CSUN; check current business information before visiting.

cards.title: Coffee, Hojicha, and Matcha
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 9225 Reseda Blvd.
cards.notes: Walk south on Reseda Boulevard when you want a café whose documented drink range includes coffee, roasted hojicha, and matcha.
cards.short_summary: A compact café choice distinguished by three clearly identified beverage traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN identifies Re: Coffee at 9225 Reseda Boulevard and states that it serves coffee, hojicha, and matcha.
cards.access_notes: Public café listed 0.5 miles from CSUN; confirm current operating details before departure.

cards.title: Breakfast Along Nordhoff
cards.subtitle: Nordhoff Street — 18401 Nordhoff St., Suite A
cards.notes: Turn onto Nordhoff Street for specialty coffee plus pastries and breakfast bites, a practical combination for a morning outing.
cards.short_summary: A Nordhoff Street coffee stop with breakfast food documented alongside its specialty drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN lists House Roots Coffee at 18401 Nordhoff Street, Suite A, and describes specialty coffee, pastries, and breakfast bites.
cards.access_notes: Public café listed 0.3 miles from CSUN; verify current operating details before visiting.

cards.title: A Lighter Lunch on Dearborn
cards.subtitle: Dearborn Street — 18436 Dearborn St.
cards.notes: Use Dearborn Street for a café stop offering coffee, smoothies, breakfast, and light lunch choices instead of a heavier meal.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Dearborn Street café covering both breakfast and lighter midday food.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN places Peak Cafe at 18436 Dearborn Street and says it offers coffee, smoothies, breakfast, and light lunch options.
cards.access_notes: Public café listed 0.3 miles from CSUN; consult current business information before departure.

cards.title: Cuban Baking on Nordhoff
cards.subtitle: Nordhoff Street — 19467 Nordhoff St.
cards.notes: Travel west on Nordhoff Street for a Cuban bakery visit spanning savory plates, pastries, and other documented comfort-food choices.
cards.short_summary: A bakery-and-café destination centered on Cuban pastries and savory food.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN lists Porto’s Bakery at 19467 Nordhoff Street and describes Cuban comfort food, savory plates, and flaky pastries.
cards.access_notes: Public bakery listed 1.5 miles from CSUN; check current operating details before making the trip.

cards.title: Breakfast and Sandwiches Southbound
cards.subtitle: Reseda Boulevard — 8926 Reseda Blvd.
cards.notes: Head south on Reseda Boulevard for a café combining coffee and pastries with hearty breakfasts and freshly made sandwiches.
cards.short_summary: A south-of-campus café where the documented menu extends beyond drinks and sweets.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUN lists Yellow House Cafe at 8926 Reseda Boulevard and describes coffee, pastries, hearty breakfasts, and fresh sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Public café listed 0.3 miles from CSUN; confirm current operating details before visiting.
